basic_details.job_title: CSL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 210 Technician and ITI Apprentice Posts
basic_details.short_information: Cochin Shipyard Limited has released Notification No. CSL/P&A/APPE/SEL. DESIGNTD/-DESIGNATED/2022/2 dated 16 Sep 2026, for the engagement of Technician (Vocational)/Trade Apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961. Interested and eligible ITI/Vocational certificate holders can apply online for One Year apprenticeship training. Register for Job Alerts

application_fee.details: The application fee for CSL Technician and ITI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 is Nil. There is no fee payable by applicants of any category for submitting the online application.

age_limit.details: The minimum age required for both ITI Trade Apprentices and Technician (Vocational) Apprentices is 18 years, as on 08.10.2026. The notification does not specify an upper age limit; physical standards are as prescribed under the Apprentices Act 1961 and Apprenticeship Rules 1992. | Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

qualification.details: CSL apprentice eligibility 2026 differs for ITI Trade Apprentices and Technician (Vocational) Apprentices, as detailed below. | Candidates who have already undergone apprenticeship training in any other organisation, for any duration, under the Apprentices Act, 1961, are not eligible to apply. Applicants with qualifications equivalent to the prescribed qualification must upload an Equivalency Certificate issued by the competent authority; without this certificate their candidature will not be considered.

No travel expenses are admissible for attending certificate verification or during the apprenticeship training period, and boarding/lodging will not be provided by CSL.

selection_process: Selection to CSL Technician (Vocational)/Trade Apprentice posts is based on shortlisting by merit
followed by certificate verification and medical fitness clearance; there is no written examination specified in the notification.
Shortlisting: Candidates will be shortlisted based on the percentage of marks obtained in the prescribed qualification applicable to the respective trade/discipline. In case of a tie in marks

relative merit will be decided based on seniority in age. Intimation to Shortlisted Candidates: Shortlisted candidates will be intimated through their registered email ID and will have to appear for certificate verification. Certificate Verification: Candidates must produce a signed printout of the online application form (with unique registration number)
original certificates towards proof of age
along with self-attested copies of these certificates. Provisional Selection: On successful completion of certificate verification
applicants will be provisionally considered for selection against the notified seats in order of merit/reservation
subject to medical fitness. Apprenticeship Contract: Selected candidates must execute the apprenticeship contract agreement through the https://apprenticeshipindia.gov.in portal.
Rank lists will be maintained for all posts and operated for seats arising during the validity period
which is up to 18 months from the date of reporting of the last candidate advised to join
unless a fresh notification is issued. Such seats will not be treated as fresh vacancies.
how_to_apply: CSL Technician and ITI Apprentice Apply Online process is conducted entirely through the CSL SAP E-recruitment portal; no offline or postal applications are accepted.
Go through the User Manual published on www.cochinshipyard.in (Career page – CSL Kochi) before filling the online application.
Complete Phase 1: One-time Registration on the SAP E-recruitment portal of CSL.
Complete Phase 2: Submission of the application against the applicable Trade/Vocation. Applicants should not submit more than one application; the application, once submitted, is final.

Upload all certificates towards proof of age, educational qualification, caste, disability (if applicable), and a recent passport-size colour photograph in the SAP online application portal - failure to do so will lead to rejection of candidature.
Applicants with equivalent qualifications must additionally upload an Equivalency Certificate issued by the competent authority.

Verify that all entries, including marks, are filled in correctly. Any difference between entered marks and the uploaded mark sheet will lead to summary rejection; no changes are allowed after final submission.
Submit the application and retain a soft copy/printout containing the unique registration number generated only upon successful submission, for future correspondence with CSL.
Online application path: www.cochinshipyard.in > Career > CSL (Kochi) > E-Recruitment – Trainees/Apprentices.
Submit the application between 16 September 2026 and 08 October 2026. Apply well in advance, as technical support may not be available after 1600 hrs on the last date.

content_sections.heading: CSL Technician and ITI Apprentice Vacancy 2026 Details
content_sections.text: A total of 210 apprenticeship seats have been notified by Cochin Shipyard Limited, split across ITI Trade Apprentices (205 seats in 16 trades) and Technician (Vocational) Apprentices (5 seats in 5 disciplines). Note: Inclusion of Marine Fitter (S.No. 16) as a designated trade is under consideration by the Directorate General of Training (DGT), Government of India. Registration of apprenticeship contracts in this trade will be possible only after DGT approval. The number of seats indicated in the notification is based on existing requirement and may vary depending on future requirements. CSL reserves the right to restrict, alter, cancel, or modify the recruitment process, and is not obligated to fill all notified seats.

content_sections.heading: CSL Technician and ITI Apprentice Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: CSL apprentice eligibility 2026 differs for ITI Trade Apprentices and Technician (Vocational) Apprentices, as detailed below. Candidates who have already undergone apprenticeship training in any other organisation, for any duration, under the Apprentices Act, 1961, are not eligible to apply. Applicants with qualifications equivalent to the prescribed qualification must upload an Equivalency Certificate issued by the competent authority; without this certificate their candidature will not be considered.

rows.iti_trade_apprentices: Pass in Xth standard; and Pass in ITI (National Trade Certificate – NTC) in any one of the notified trades
rows.technician_vocational_apprentices: Pass in Vocational Higher Secondary Education (VHSE) in the concerned discipline

rows.iti_trade_apprentices: As prescribed in the Apprentices Act 1961, Apprenticeship Rules 1992, and amendments thereof, if any
The applicant shall be a domicile of Kerala
Applicable as per Government of India Rules

content_sections.heading: CSL Technician and ITI Apprentice Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The minimum age required for both ITI Trade Apprentices and Technician (Vocational) Apprentices is 18 years, as on 08.10.2026. The notification does not specify an upper age limit; physical standards are as prescribed under the Apprentices Act 1961 and Apprenticeship Rules 1992. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: CSL Technician and ITI Apprentice Stipend 2026
content_sections.text: Selected apprentices, under both the ITI Trade Apprentice and Technician (Vocational) Apprentice categories, will receive a stipend of Rs. 11,000/- per month during the one-year apprenticeship training period. No travel expenses are admissible for attending certificate verification or during the apprenticeship training period, and boarding/lodging will not be provided by CSL.

content_sections.heading: CSL Technician and ITI Apprentice Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The application fee for CSL Technician and ITI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 is Nil . There is no fee payable by applicants of any category for submitting the online application.

content_sections.heading: CSL Technician and ITI Apprentice Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection to CSL Technician (Vocational)/Trade Apprentice posts is based on shortlisting by merit, followed by certificate verification and medical fitness clearance; there is no written examination specified in the notification. Shortlisting: Candidates will be shortlisted based on the percentage of marks obtained in the prescribed qualification applicable to the respective trade/discipline. In case of a tie in marks, relative merit will be decided based on seniority in age. Intimation to Shortlisted Candidates: Shortlisted candidates will be intimated through their registered email ID and will have to appear for certificate verification. Certificate Verification: Candidates must produce a signed printout of the online application form (with unique registration number), original certificates towards proof of age, qualification, caste, and disability (if any), along with self-attested copies of these certificates. Provisional Selection: On successful completion of certificate verification, applicants will be provisionally considered for selection against the notified seats in order of merit/reservation, subject to medical fitness. Apprenticeship Contract: Selected candidates must execute the apprenticeship contract agreement through the https://apprenticeshipindia.gov.in portal. Rank lists will be maintained for all posts and operated for seats arising during the validity period, which is up to 18 months from the date of reporting of the last candidate advised to join, unless a fresh notification is issued. Such seats will not be treated as fresh vacancies.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSL Technician and ITI Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: CSL Technician and ITI Apprentice Apply Online process is conducted entirely through the CSL SAP E-recruitment portal; no offline or postal applications are accepted. Go through the User Manual published on www.cochinshipyard.in (Career page – CSL Kochi) before filling the online application. Complete Phase 1: One-time Registration on the SAP E-recruitment portal of CSL. Complete Phase 2: Submission of the application against the applicable Trade/Vocation. Applicants should not submit more than one application; the application, once submitted, is final. Upload all certificates towards proof of age, educational qualification, caste, disability (if applicable), and a recent passport-size colour photograph in the SAP online application portal - failure to do so will lead to rejection of candidature. Applicants with equivalent qualifications must additionally upload an Equivalency Certificate issued by the competent authority. Verify that all entries, including marks, are filled in correctly. Any difference between entered marks and the uploaded mark sheet will lead to summary rejection; no changes are allowed after final submission. Submit the application and retain a soft copy/printout containing the unique registration number generated only upon successful submission, for future correspondence with CSL. Online application path: www.cochinshipyard.in > Career > CSL (Kochi) > E-Recruitment – Trainees/Apprentices. Submit the application between 16 September 2026 and 08 October 2026. Apply well in advance, as technical support may not be available after 1600 hrs on the last date.

faq.question: Q1. What is CSL Technician and ITI Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a notification (No. CSL/P&A/APPE/SEL. DESIGNTD/-DESIGNATED/2022/2 dated 16 Sep 2026) issued by Cochin Shipyard Limited for engagement of Technician (Vocational)/Trade Apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961, for One Year apprenticeship training, offering a total of 210 seats.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in CSL Technician and ITI Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 210 seats are available: 205 seats across 16 trades for ITI Trade Apprentices, and 5 seats across 5 disciplines for Technician (Vocational) Apprentices.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for CSL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the online application is 08.10.2026. Online registration commenced on 16.09.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for CSL Technician and ITI Apprentice?
faq.answer: ITI Trade Apprentices need a pass in Xth standard along with a pass in ITI (National Trade Certificate) in the relevant trade. Technician (Vocational) Apprentices need a pass in Vocational Higher Secondary Education (VHSE) in the concerned discipline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for CSL Technician and ITI Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age required is 18 years as on 08.10.2026. No upper age limit is specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for CSL Technician and ITI Apprentice 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Nil for all applicants.

faq.question: Q7. What is the stipend for CSL Technician and ITI Apprentice 2026?
faq.answer: Selected apprentices will receive a stipend of Rs. 11,000/- per month during the one-year apprenticeship training period.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply online for CSL Technician and ITI Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must visit www.cochinshipyard.in, complete one-time registration on the SAP E-recruitment portal, submit the application against the applicable trade/vocation, upload the required certificates and photograph, and submit before the closing date.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for CSL Technician and ITI Apprentice?
faq.answer: Selection is based on shortlisting by percentage of marks in the prescribed qualification (with age used as a tie-breaker), followed by certificate verification, medical fitness clearance, and provisional selection in order of merit/reservation. There is no written examination.

faq.question: Q10. Is domicile required for CSL Technician and ITI Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, the applicant must be a domicile of Kerala.
